notes: Key adversarial case for Layer 6. This examiner DOES belong to the Merkle tree of accredited examiners (the membership proof would always pass) — but has a validity GAP between 2026-02-01 and 2026-06-01 from not renewing on time. VELO-009 (2026-01-16) falls in the first period — VALID. VELO-006 (2026-04-10) falls right in the gap — EXPIRED, must be rejected even though the examiner belongs to the tree. VELO-010 (2026-07-20) falls in the second period after re-licensing — VALID again. The circuit must check validity at the exact date of EACH attestation, not a global validity for the examiner — same examiner, three different outcomes depending on when they attested. It's the Layer-6 equivalent of VELO-004-cadena-rota (ABSTAIN for broken chain of custody, not for verdict): here the rejection is for validity, not for membership.
